correctness.rationale: Necessity: two initially uncoloured peripherals of one petal block each other forever; with an uncoloured hub no peripheral can force first, and hub forces precisely when all m-1 peripheral colours are present. Sufficiency: after the hub is initially coloured or forced, every single peripheral blank sees m-1 distinct colours and forces. Each successful restriction uniquely identifies a proper total m-colouring, so no double counting. Subtract exactly m-1 monochromatic omitted-colour patterns to obtain B and the weighted probability formula. The top t coefficient is strictly positive for k>=2,m>=3. Direct exhaustive checks corroborate but are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Entire coefficient and probability polynomials are determined for all nontrivial clique bouquets in a new, generally hard-to-evaluate chromatic forcing model. The proof isolates the coupling through one shared hub: independent local omission decisions fail exactly on m-1 global constant-colour patterns. It also supplies a sharp minimum seed size k(m-2) and precise number of optimal labelled seeds; this is a natural structural exact-enumeration problem, not a one-off computation.
